title: Todd Bowles: Baker Mayfield's made progress, decision on playing to come on Friday

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Todd Bowles: Baker Mayfield's made progress, decision on playing to come on Friday
sources.description: Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield missed practice on Wednesday with a foot injury, but the team hasn't made a decision on his availability for Sunday's game against the Lions.
